headline: Congress pays respects to 9/11 anniversary with pro forma sessions and next week's judiciary vote looming

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met in pro forma session on September 10, taking just 30 seconds to convene and adjourn. The chamber observed the 25th anniversary of the September 11 terrorist attacks.

onTheFloor.title: Cloture vote on nomination of Matthew R. Byrne, of Ohio, to be United States District Judge for the Southern District of Ohio
onTheFloor.status: Cloture vote scheduled for approximately 5:30 PM Monday, September 14

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met for just 3 minutes on September 10 to pass H. Res. 1520, expressing the sense of the House regarding the 25th anniversary of the September 11 terrorist attacks. The chamber adjourned early as a mark of respect to the victims.

onTheFloor.title: Expressing the sense of the House of Representatives regarding the terrorist attacks launched against the United States on September 11, 2001, on the 25th anniversary of that date
